question: Which public fabrication and package numbers bound the PiSXMe U11/U12 storage geometry, and do the retained footprints match their package authorities?

U11.authority_status: project package basis established; paste/mask/courtyard production review remains open
U11.relevance: JLC multilayer 0.09/0.09 mm minimum and 0.10 mm pad-to-track minimum bound the selected local 0.10/0.10 mm crystal escape; ordinary 0.60/0.30 mm through-vias remain above the published minimum.

U12.relevance: The local land dimensions and thermal pad match the TI example values, but local pad-center pitch is 0.40 mm while TI's generic package view states 0.50 mm pitch. JLC capability cannot resolve package identity.

jlcpcb_general_multilayer.blind_buried_vias: not supported on stated standard process

conflicts.subject: U12 HD3SS6126 RUA0042A pad pitch
conflicts.authority_assertion: TI generic package view states 0.50 mm pitch; package outline includes 42X 0.5 and 38X 0.5 callouts.
conflicts.project_assertion: Retained PiSXMeRevAClean:HD3SS6126_RUA0042A footprint uses 0.40 mm pad-center increments on all four sides.
conflicts.implication: Do not treat the retained U12 footprint as package-authoritative or authorize routing from it until package authority reconciles the pitch.

conflicts.subject: advertised 6-layer maximum board dimensions
conflicts.capabilities_page: 656 x 586 mm for 6-layer-and-above FR-4 at thickness >=0.8 mm
conflicts.implication: Not material to U11/U12 local geometry; obtain a stackup/DFM review if board dimensions approach either advertised limit.

limits: JLC pages are capability statements, not a fabrication acceptance for this board or a guarantee of yield for the U11/U12 escapes.
TI example land and stencil dimensions are package design references; they do not replace an assembly house review.
No independent public source in this task reconciles the U12 0.40-vs-0.50 mm pitch conflict.
No conclusion about U11 package authority is added beyond the existing project-derived JMicron record.
